subject: PO onboarding: SunVector net terms, XML PO schema, and invoice pulse options
body:
From: Asha Mehra <asha.mehra@sunvector.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Klein <devon.klein@sunvector.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO onboarding: PO XML schema + preferred invoice cadence and net terms

Hi Ethan —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement at SunVector is ready to move forward but we have a couple of requirements from our AP team before we can issue a blanket PO:

- The PO must arrive in our XML format (attached: SunVector_PO_Template_v3.xml).
- We need Net-90 on the contract.
- Invoice cadence: our ERP prefers a weekly invoice pulse to reconcile consumption; can you support weekly invoicing against a single PO ID?
- We also need SOC2 evidence and a short data-processing summary for our records (SOC2_Attestation.pdf would be perfect).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept an XML PO feed (SFTP or API), and whether Net-90 + weekly invoice pulses are feasible? If not, any alternative suggestions that Procurement can present to Finance would help.

Best,
Asha Mehra
Senior Procurement Manager
SunVector Systems

---

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Mehra <asha.mehra@sunvector.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO onboarding: PO XML schema + preferred invoice cadence and net terms

Hi Asha —

Appreciate the clear ask and the template — that helps. Short answers up front: we can accept an XML PO feed, and we can do weekly invoice pulses, but Net-90 is outside our standard hosted terms and will need finance approval (and a minor commercial adjustment).

Details: 
- XML PO: our billing team has worked with similar XML payloads. We support SFTP drop and a partner API ingest. Vanessa, can you confirm the expected ingest SLA and whether we need any field mapping exceptions for the PO template Asha attached?
- Weekly invoices: yes, our finance system can issue weekly itemized invoices tied to a single PO ID. We typically require a minimum invoice amount threshold to avoid excessive small-value invoices; Marissa, adding you for the threshold / operations question.
- Net-90: our default hosted Net is Net-30 / Net-45 for committed contracts. For Net-90 we typically require either (a) a short managed credit holdback or (b) an early-pay discount to offset extended float. If SunVector is set on Net-90, we can route to finance for a Net-90 exception but it'll likely come with a 2-3% fee or a prepayment ladder.

Proposed path: Ethan here -> I'll loop in Prioyom for legal on PO acceptance language; Vanessa/Marissa coordinate on the XML ingest and invoice-floor. If SunVector can accept a small service credit in lieu of a fee, that may be a quicker path.

I can be on a quick call later today if helpful.

Thanks,
Ethan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Mehra <asha.mehra@sunvector.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO onboarding: PO XML schema + preferred invoice cadence and net terms

Hi Asha —

Quick operational notes from billing: we can ingest the attached SunVector_PO_Template_v3.xml via SFTP; we will need a sample of a populated PO so our parser team can validate field mapping (particularly the PO line item SKU code and the tax/entity tags). Could you send 1-2 sample POs?

Weekly invoice pulse: we support that, but to manage AP load we enforce a $200 minimum invoice floor OR we group low-value events into a rolling weekly summary (this avoids dozens of sub-$50 invoices). If SunVector prefers individual itemized weekly invoices regardless of value, we'll need to add a manual handling fee.

Net-90: as Ethan said, that requires finance approval. Typical options we present: 
- Option A: Net-90 with 2.5% financing fee (applied to invoice amount)
- Option B: Net-60 standard + 30-day vendor prepay on a small % of committed spend
- Option C: Net-90 with a $50k credit line holdback on initial 90 days (refundable against usage)

If you can indicate which option SunVector prefers we can send an estimate for the fee or propose credit holdback language for legal.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

---

From: Asha Mehra <asha.mehra@sunvector.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Klein <devon.klein@sunvector.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO onboarding: PO XML schema + preferred invoice cadence and net terms

Thanks — useful options. A few clarifying notes from SunVector Finance / AP (copied Devon):
- We can supply two sample populated POs by EOD.
- We prefer Option B (Net-60 + 30-day prepay of 10% of monthly committed spend) rather than a direct fee — that plays better with our internal payables scorecards.
- Weekly pulse: we insist on fully itemized weekly invoices tied to usage. The $200 minimum could be a blocker; is there a programmatic way to roll low-dollar events into a single weekly invoice with full item detail but consolidated totals?

We want to minimize manual handling. If your parser can accept the sample PO and return a mapping report, that would help fast-track. Also please send the SOC2 evidence and the data-processing summary to Devon for compliance.

Regards,
Asha

---

From: Prioyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Mehra <asha.mehra@sunvector.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 11:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO onboarding: PO XML schema + preferred invoice cadence and net terms

Hi all —

Legal/Commercial here. If SunVector is happy with Option B (Net-60 + 10% prepay), we can draft an addendum that: 
- Accepts XML PO ingestion as valid purchase order acceptance (we'll include an SFTP/API ingest clause and an acknowledgment receipt requirement).
- Confirms invoice cadence can be weekly with consolidated totals and itemized lines for reconciliation. We'll include a clause that Redwood will group micro-transactions automatically into a single weekly invoice, but provide item-level detail as a machine-readable attach (CSV) to avoid manual line-item matching.
- For the prepay, we'll add explicit refund/reconciliation language after 60 days.

One caveat: we should agree on the exact XML field mapping (PO_line.sku -> Redwood_product_id), and define a 3-business-day acknowledgment window from Redwood on PO receipt; absent acknowledgment the PO is considered unaccepted until corrected. Please confirm acceptance of the 3-business-day SLA.

If that sounds good, Marissa, can you prepare the billing-side reconciliation language and a sample weekly invoice layout we can attach to the addendum?

Thanks,
Prioyom Das
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

---

From: Devon Klein <devon.klein@sunvector.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Prioyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Mehra <asha.mehra@sunvector.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO onboarding: PO XML schema + preferred invoice cadence and net terms

Ethan / Prioyom / Vanessa —

This looks workable. SunVector accepts Option B (Net-60 + 10% monthly prepay) and the 3-business-day acknowledgment SLA. We'll send two sample populated POs and confirm SFTP details by EOD Thursday. Also, SOC2_Attestation.pdf received — thanks.

Next step: can Redwood share the mapping report after your parser validates our sample PO? If so, we can loop in our ERP team and sign the addendum.

Regards,
Devon Klein
Director, Vendor Payments
SunVector Systems
